---
title: "Linear B Diachronic Phonological Mapper"
date: 2025-11-19
description: >
  An interactive web tool for transcribing, analysing and visualising the phonological
  evolution of Linear B (Mycenaean Greek, c. 1450 to 1200 BCE) into Classical Greek
  (c. 800 to 400 BCE).
categories: [Digital humanities, Ancient Greek]
repo: https://github.com/ellacapellini/Linear-B-Diachronic-Phonological-Mapper
---

The tool transcribes Linear B syllabograms, segments words into stems and endings,
generates inflected forms for a lemma, and animates the sound changes that lead
to Classical Greek on a timeline. Its rule engine covers more than ten ordered
sound changes, such as loss of the digamma and the splits of the labiovelars.
